summary: First testing run for Bolt/Forum app. Backend: ALL 10 pytest tests PASS (categories, register, login admin/demo, full thread CRUD with vote/comment/pin/lock/locked-comment-403/non-owner-delete-403/admin-delete, profile update, image upload+serve, tags, stats, logout, unauth thread create). Frontend: Home renders with neo-brutalist hero, categories sidebar (6 cats), sort tabs (Hot/New/Top). Login flow works (session_token cookie set, 'Welcome back' toast, user avatar in navbar). Search route works. Found one routing bug: /profile route is not registered ('No routes matched location /profile') - profile likely uses /u/:id or similar.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to /profile shows blank page with React Router warning 'No routes matched location /profile'. Either Profile.jsx is not registered at /profile or it expects /u/:id. Navbar avatar/profile link should point to the correct path.

issues: Page title is generic 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of Bolt/Forum brand

action_items: Verify Profile route in /app/frontend/src/App.js — register <Route path='/profile' element={<Profile/>}/> or update navbar avatar link to the actual path (e.g., /u/:user_id).
critical_code_review_comments: CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec; browsers may reject cookies from other origins. Currently works because frontend and backend share the same origin via ingress, but should be set to explicit origin for production.
set_session_cookie hardcodes secure=True, samesite='none' — fine on HTTPS preview, will break on plain http localhost dev.
init_storage stores storage_key in module-global; not thread-safe under multi-worker, but acceptable for single worker.
seed_data_creation: Test threads/comments created via API are auto-cleaned (admin deletes test thread). One TEST_ user registered per run remains in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully green via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Re-test only frontend after profile-route fix. Login UI works — confirm by checking for 'D' avatar tile in top-right after login. /search?q=... works. Admin panel and pin/lock/delete buttons not yet exercised in UI; next iteration should login as admin@forum.com, create a thread, then test /admin route and pin/lock/delete buttons on Thread page. Note: Vote toggle logic on backend is correct (verified: author auto-upvote=1, admin downvote brings score to 0, removing vote restores to 1).
